verdict: Paid leads surging, but none are reaching your pipeline yet.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 139 leads from Meta at a cost of $12.85 per lead — well below the July peak of $45 per lead, and up nearly 30% week over week. The ads are working. The problem is downstream: all 139 leads show no appointments or active opportunities in your intake system, which means contacts are arriving but not being followed up in a way that moves them toward cases. We're focused on closing that intake gap now. In parallel, organic visibility — your Google Business Profile — dropped sharply this week, and a posting cadence is being activated to reverse that.

highlights.phrase: leads received in the last 28 days via paid Meta ads
cost per lead this period, down 16% from the prior week
more leads this week compared to the week before

watch_item.issue: 139 leads delivered this period, but zero have converted to appointments or active pipeline — indicating an intake gap, not an ads problem.
watch_item.fix: Intake flow is being reviewed and corrected this week to ensure leads are reached and logged properly.
